### Description
Make your console feel next gen again. Or keep the retro vibes going with a custom mod!

The Game Console Toolkit is built for optimal console repair on modern hardware and retro classics alike. Whether you’re servicing an Xbox or a PlayStation, a Steam Deck or vintage Nintendo consoles, a 16-bit driver kit and specialty opening and cleaning tools were curated specifically to keep you in the game.

At the core is the Game Console Driver Kit, designed around the screws actually found in game consoles. Gamebits open original Nintendo cartridges and housings. Tri-point bits get you inside a Switch. Torx Security bits handle Xbox controllers. Joy-Con drift taking you on unwanted side quests? Broken disc drive? This kit has the bits to press R to revive. A precision cleaning brush assortment, compact metal spudger, angled tweezers, and opening picks will get you in and keep things clean. And the all-in-one organized roll is eminently portable and even has a dedicated slot for your next upgrade: the [Thermal Performance Kit](/products/thermal-performance-kit) (available separately) helps your console handle the heat.

Drift happens. Don’t replace, repair.

### Description
The Megalodon Driver Kit is iFixit's dedicated driver kit for home repair. Built for the space between your precision electronics kit and the drill in the garage, it pairs a driver handle featuring iFixit’s push-to-lock Swivel Grip Cap with 16 extended-reach 2” bits sized for real household repairs.

Oftentimes, home repairs don't need a full-size drill or a delicate electronics set. They need a driver that can reach a screw two inches down a vacuum cleaner housing, muscle a dishwasher panel back into place, or reassemble furniture without stripping the hardware. Megalodon is built for exactly those jobs.

The push-to-lock Swivel Grip Cap gives you speed when you're spinning freely and torque when you need to bear down—all without a complicated ratchet mechanism that puts you in the wrong position half the time.

The 16 included bits are curated for the fasteners you actually find at home: Phillips 0–2, Flathead, TR10–TR25 Torx, Hex, Square, a 5/16" nut driver, and a 1/4" socket adapter. Every bit is labeled in large, legible white print on the foam. The case lid is held magnetically, flips to the back while you work, and doubles as a sorting tray when you need it.

# **Case Studies**
**GUIDES, PARTS, AND TOOLS**

## Motorola
Motorola has prioritized repairability for a long time, so we’re proud they chose us as their [repair partner](https://www.ifixit.com/collaborations/motorola). In 2018, Motorola became the first major smartphone manufacturer to offer official replacement parts direct to customers, available around the world through our [store](https://www.ifixit.com/Parts/Motorola_Android_Phone).

It’s proof that official and DIY repair can thrive together. Motorola customers can either send their device directly to Motorola for repair or fix it at home with the highest quality parts and tools, plus a free step-by-step guide, all included in our Fix Kits.

![](https://valkyrie.cdn.ifixit.com/media/2025/09/03090032/Motorola-Partnership-3.jpeg)

![](https://valkyrie.cdn.ifixit.com/media/2025/08/28105042/Services-LP4.png)

Customers rave about their experience fixing their own Motos. ***70% of Fix Kit customers said the experience makes them more likely to buy a Motorola phone in the future.*** They also feel confident knowing that iFixit tools and OEM parts come backed by the manufacturer.

**GUIDES AND CUSTOM SOLUTIONS**

## Patagonia
![](https://valkyrie.cdn.ifixit.com/media/2025/09/03081615/Seams-and-Stitches-New.png)

Patagonia sets the bar high when it comes to making clothes that last. They don’t just repair and resell their own used clothes through [Worn Wear](https://wornwear.patagonia.com/)—they also partner with iFixit to make top-notch care and repair information available through the [Patagonia Repair Hub](https://www.ifixit.com/collaborations/patagonia).

This partnership highlights our ability to craft a custom solution to fit any need. We worked with Patagonia’s materials experts to create a detailed [Garment Care Guide](https://www.ifixit.com/Wiki/Patagonia_Product_Care) with instructions for laundering rain jackets, reapplying waterproofing, removing stains, and caring for a huge range of fabrics.

Patagonia also wanted to make their internal repair documentation available to anyone. We were happy to help. From [clothing and gear repairs](https://www.ifixit.com/collaborations/patagonia#repair) to all-purpose [sewing skills](https://www.ifixit.com/Wiki/Patagonia_Sewing_Skills), Patagonia and iFixit teamed up to support all kinds of repairs—and show customers that Patagonia is serious about their mission to “protect our home planet.”

“Repair should be accessible, open, and everywhere,” says Clara Redwood, Global Repair Experience Manager at Patagonia. “That’s why our partnership with iFixit is so important. ***They help us spread repair knowledge far and wide and encourage people to try DIY fixes***.”

![](https://valkyrie.cdn.ifixit.com/media/2025/08/27135329/Pat-Mobile-Transparent.png)

**PARTS, TOOLS, AND SNAPSHOTS**

## Google
iFixit is Google’s go-to choice for [spare parts distribution](https://www.ifixit.com/Parts/Google_Phone) and repairability consulting. We worked side-by-side to establish an entire DIY repair ecosystem including genuine parts, comprehensive [guides](https://www.ifixit.com/Device/Google_Phone), and complete Fix Kits. This program offers localized global coverage and has received high praise from customers and the tech press. All of Google’s self-repair ecosystem is neatly available in their custom [Repair Hub](https://www.ifixit.com/collaborations/google).

In a world where most consumers think they should be able to fix their stuff, Google has chosen to lead instead of being dragged along.

![](https://valkyrie.cdn.ifixit.com/media/2025/09/05082510/pixelsquare.jpg)

![](https://valkyrie.cdn.ifixit.com/media/2025/08/27135550/Google-Mobile-Transparent.png)

“From our industry-first “Repair Mode” to updated manuals and parts distribution, ***we’re making it easier than ever for both DIYers and professionals to repair Pixel phones***,” says Prem Pandian, Global Head of Strategic Initiatives and Partnerships at Google.

Google promises products that last. We help them deliver.

## Repair Makes Cents
Making products repairable unlocks new profit streams: high-margin service and parts sales (about 25 % EBIT vs. 10 % from new goods), take‑back and refurbishment programs, modular upgrades, and insights from real-world use to optimize future offerings.

[Keep Reading](https://www.ifixit.com/News/80311/repair-makes-cents)

![](https://valkyrie.cdn.ifixit.com/media/2025/08/15090837/repair.png)

## Repair Builds Brand Loyalty
Repair ecosystems help brands become iconic by delivering high‑quality products, swift support, transparency, personalization, and ethical responsibility—building deep trust. That trust beats price wars and slows planned obsolescence, driving customer loyalty, retention, and long‑term brand value.

[Keep Reading](https://www.ifixit.com/News/76806/fixing-to-be-an-iconic-brand-how-repair-ecosystems-build-brand-loyalty)

## Repair Is Sustainable
Enabling and supporting repair is one concrete way companies can reduce their environmental impacts without hurting their bottom lines. Waste, especially e-waste, is hurting our planet, and repair is the best way to fight it—even better than recycling.

[Keep Reading](https://www.ifixit.com/News/112586/how-repair-saves-the-world)

![](https://valkyrie.cdn.ifixit.com/media/2025/08/15083351/Instagram-Square-agbogbloshie_photos_2012.jpg)

![](https://valkyrie.cdn.ifixit.com/media/2026/02/11120621/8-Speaking-A.png)

## **Interactive Repair Guidance**
FixBot is iFixit’s new AI-powered repair assistant, built on more than 20 years of trusted repair expertise. It turns iFixit’s extensive library of guides and technical knowledge into step-by-step guidance your customers can actually follow, without overwhelming your support team.

Users describe a problem by text or voice, and FixBot helps diagnose the issue, directs them to the right repair steps, and recommends the exact parts and tools required. The result is fast expert-backed repair guidance that’s easier to access, easier to follow, and easier to scale.

[Learn more about FixBot](https://fixbot.pro/)

## The Six Things That Make or Break Repairability
The journey to enabling repair starts with three simple steps: Make repair instructions easily accessible, develop a spare parts supply chain, and ensure products can be easily disassembled *and* reassembled. But unrepairable design, unsupported software, and paired parts can thwart even the best repair efforts.

[Keep Reading](https://www.ifixit.com/News/64609/the-six-things-that-make-or-break-repairability)

![](https://valkyrie.cdn.ifixit.com/media/2025/08/15093731/steam-deck.png)

![](https://valkyrie.cdn.ifixit.com/media/2025/08/15085017/mbp-w-guide-square.png)

## Designing a Repair Ecosystem
A repair ecosystem includes everything needed for a user to complete a repair, whether that’s at a service center, through mail-in service, or through a DIY option. At minimum, that means guides, parts, and tools must be available. It can be challenging to make this from scratch, but you might be further along than you think!

[Keep Reading](https://www.ifixit.com/News/111354/designing-a-repair-ecosystem-a-guide-for-oems)

## Why DIY Repair Matters
Many manufacturers already have programs that support mail-in or service center repair. But that’s not always best for consumers. DIY repair creates accessibility, loyalty, and profit, all while being the best bet to ensure Right to Repair compliance.

[Keep Reading](https://www.ifixit.com/News/112595/service-center-repair-isnt-enough)
